question: Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibushan awardee, Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, was instrumental in reviving which of the following classical dances?
solution:
The correct option is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibushan** awardee,** Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra**, was instrumental in reviving the classical dance form of **Odissi.**
 
• Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was a renowned Indian** classical dancer and choreographer **who played a significant role in popularizing Odissi dance form across the world.
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India that originated in the eastern state of** Odisha**.
 
• It has a rich history and is known for its **graceful movements, expressions, and intricate footwork.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi** is a classical dance form that originated in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**.

 
 
• It is known for its fast-paced footwork and **dramatic storytelling.**
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance form that originated in the southern state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
 
• It is known for its** grace, symmetry, and expressive storytelling.**
 
 
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form that originated in the northeastern state of **Manipur. **
 
 
• **​**It is known for its** fluid movements, delicate footwork, and devotional themes.**
